svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Immich storage migration: WD Red Plus to Toshiba
2026-05-28 on grey-server: LXC 110 docker-main's /data moved from ZFS pool hddpool (WD 4 TB) to hddpool-1 (Toshiba 2 TB) with Immich v2.7.5 stopped, verified, then the WD retired
WDC WD40EFPX-68C6CN0, single-disk ZFS pool. It also held stale calibre and
Nextcloud leftovers and three empty datasets, all removed before the copy.
Immich 1.9 TB before the purge, 825 GB after
kept mounted until every check below passed
40 MB gz, 103 MB raw; copied off the node
Toshiba DT01ACA200 with prior use: SMART PASSED, zero reallocated, pending
or CRC errors, but high power-on hours, so the WD copy stayed until verified.
about 132 MB/s, finished in under two hours
1 · map every guest and bind mount that used hddpool: LXC 110 /data; immich_server, immich_postgres, forgejo
2 · move Forgejo to NVMe; delete the stale leftovers and the three empty datasets
3 · fresh database dump, gzip and header/footer checked, copied off grey-server
4 · wipe the Toshiba, GPT label, create hddpool-1 in the Proxmox UI by persistent device path
5 · docker compose down; delete encoded-video only, 1.9 TB to 825 GB; thumbs kept
6 · stop LXC 110; pct move-volume 110 mp0 hddpool-1 without the delete flag
7 · start the LXC and Immich; run the checks
8 · zfs destroy, zpool destroy, pvesm remove; rebuild the transcode cache; pull the WD
Checks before the WD was touched
/data mounted from hddpool-1, Immich directories present
server, postgres, machine learning and redis healthy
timeline loads; album covers and named people present
hddpool-1 is one disk, no redundancy
pct move-volume 110 mp0 hddpool-1 · 886 GB, 32,000 files, 132 MB/s

Database dumps hold metadata only and must be paired with the files; thumbs and encoded-video are regenerable, library, upload, profile and the PostgreSQL directory are not. The record keeps no transcript or screenshots.
On 2026-09-24 Immich ran v3.2.2 on the same LXC with the library still on hddpool-1.
Source: Platforms/Immich/Documentation/Change Records/Storage Migration from WD Red Plus to Toshiba - 2026-05-28.md, Guides/Immich-Storage-Migration.md
